t: You're standing where St Mary Colechurch once stood. It was a parish church in the City of London, destroyed in the Great Fire of 1666 and never rebuilt, so nothing of it remains. Katherine Austen was born here in 1629. She became a diarist and poet, best known for Book M, a manuscript of meditations, journal entries and verse. She was also a successful financier and landowner, and she kept that standing by remaining a widow for twenty-five years.
